answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 27 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in cedar, queued in marble, and lotus publishes the wait time. A farm of 312 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1973 identities would post 4069 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
